name: API Error Recovery
description: Makes TPM resilient to transient server-side API errors when delegating to subagents: on a qualifying infra failure (529 Overloaded, 5xx, 429, model temporarily unavailable) it checks Claude status, backs off, and redeploys a fresh subagent with the same task, up to a hard retry cap. Never auto-retries a genuine task failure.

posture.label: Posture
posture.description: How TPM handles a qualifying transient API failure. autonomous (default): TPM checks Claude status and retries automatically, narrating each step as it goes. ask: TPM reports the failure and the status result, then waits for the user to approve before redeploying. Per the preamble's parameter-authority rule this value is authoritative over any looser default.

maxRetries.label: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Hard cap on total retry attempts for a single failed delegation before TPM stops and escalates to the user. This is a non-relaxable safety stop: TPM never loops past it and never ignores it. Attempt 1 is the first redeploy after the original failure.

backoffSeconds.label: Backoff Seconds
backoffSeconds.description: Comma-separated escalating wait, in seconds, before each retry attempt: the first value is the wait before attempt 1, the second before attempt 2, and so on. If there are more attempts than values, the last value is reused. Empty means no wait between attempts.

checkStatusPage.label: Check Status Page
checkStatusPage.description: When on (default), TPM fetches the Claude status page on a qualifying failure and reports the incident indicator in one line before retrying. When off, TPM skips the status check and proceeds straight to backoff and redeploy. A failed status fetch never blocks recovery either way.

statusUrl.label: Status URL
statusUrl.description: Read-only URL TPM GETs to read Claude service health. Defaults to the Atlassian Statuspage summary endpoint, whose JSON exposes status.indicator, status.description, and an incidents array. Fetched only when Check Status Page is on.

retriableErrors.label: Retriable Error Signatures
retriableErrors.default: 529, 500, 502, 503, 504, 429, Overloaded, API Error, terminated early due to an API error, overloaded_error, temporarily unavailable
retriableErrors.description: Comma-separated HTTP status codes and text markers that classify a subagent failure as a transient server-side/infra error eligible for retry. Anything NOT matching one of these is treated as a genuine task failure and reported normally, never auto-retried. Per the preamble's parameter-authority rule these signatures are authoritative for what counts as retriable.

reduceConcurrencyOnOverload.label: Reduce Concurrency On Overload
reduceConcurrencyOnOverload.description: When on (default), an overload/429 failure prompts TPM to reduce parallelism and stagger dispatch on redeploy — fewer simultaneous subagents to ease pressure during an incident. When off, TPM redeploys at the same concurrency. Applies only to overload/rate-limit signatures, not other transient errors.
